description: Defines classes and structures for MPEG table parsing, including PAT and PMT, with iterators for program and stream data.

classes.name: PAT
classes.description: Represents MPEG Program Association Table with iterator for programs.

classes.name: ProgramIterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing programs in PAT.

classes.name: PMT
classes.description: Represents MPEG Program Map Table with iterator for streams.

classes.name: StreamIterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing streams in PMT.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the PID associated with the program or stream.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the table or stream is valid.
